execution_scope: Read-only inspection of public derived repository artifacts, exact row-ID reconciliation, and exploratory duplicate-sensitivity replay of published descriptor/topology CSVs. Source PDFs and original masks were not downloaded or independently hashed; no fresh geometry extraction performed.

catalog_plate_record_ids_vs_descriptor_f.note: Corrected prior receipt: compare catalog.id to descriptors.formation_id, not catalog.formation_id. The latter is an F#### duplicate-group key. All 3,386 plate record IDs match descriptor row IDs exactly.

descriptor_ids_vs_topology_ids.note: descriptors.formation_id and topology.formation_id are row-level IDs (yYYYY_pNNN), not catalog F#### group keys.

set_reconciliation.stable_identifier_note: Identifier namespaces: catalog.id matches formation_ids.csv.formation_id_key and descriptors.csv / data/phase8_topology.csv formation_id row keys. catalog.formation_id is the F#### duplicate-group key. Do not compare catalog.formation_id directly to descriptor/topology row keys.

discrepancies.evidence: Catalog has 3386 plate rows plus one composite_illustration row; five plate rows are marked nonrepresentative across four repeated formation groups. Descriptor and topology tables each contain 3386 rows and match the plate row IDs exactly. Distinct catalog group keys: 3381 among plate rows and 3382 including the composite illustration.
discrepancies.unresolved_question: The README headline count of 3382 matches the number of distinct catalog group keys only when the composite_illustration row is included. The source classification explicitly marks that row as a composite rather than a plate, so the intended semantics of the headline count remain unresolved.

discrepancies.issue: 148 tests in README/findings summary versus 161 in test log/Phase 8 report
discrepancies.evidence: test_log.csv has 161 rows, with 13 Phase 8 rows; PHASE8_REPORT.md states 161 tests now logged, while findings_summary.md says 148.
discrepancies.unresolved_question: The arithmetic strongly suggests the summary was not updated after adding 13 Phase 8 tests, but the inspected files do not explicitly document that update history.

gate1_decision.reason: Record-level IDs reconcile exactly across catalog, formation-ID index, descriptors, and topology. The composite illustration is consistently excluded from descriptor/topology rows. The headline count semantics remain unresolved because 3382 distinct catalog group keys include the composite row, versus 3381 groups among plate rows; README/findings summary test count 148 also conflicts with 161 in the test log and Phase 8 report.
gate1_decision.next_required_action: Keep HOLD on formal promotion; prioritize analysis of available derived data. Maintainer clarification is useful but not a prerequisite for exploratory sensitivity tests.

statistical_claim: Exploratory duplicate-sensitivity replay now performed separately in CCFA-3382-DUPLICATE-SENSITIVITY-001. It is not an independent reproduction because source PDFs/masks were not recovered.
exploratory_sensitivity_result: Spearman(year,b1) was 0.345551 for all 3386 plate rows and 0.344611 for 3381 representative rows; rank-residual partial association controlling for primitive count was 0.136209 vs 0.135917. Duplicate handling barely changes point estimates. Formal p-values and cluster-aware uncertainty were not recomputed in this sensitivity pass.
